design_summary: Core gameplay mechanics for The Ultimate Muffin: physics-driven traversal (grappling hook, dual-grapple tethers, physics chains/ropes), universal combat systems shared across all classes, environmental traps and hazards, and supporting physics like the entity mass/weight model. Most surfaces shipped across the v0.9.x and v0.10.x release lines, with later refactors extracting per-class logic into reusable components. A handful of developer-facing design memos (animation roadmap, input mapping, velocity audit) remain partly aspirational.

standalone_designs.title: Procedural Animation Roadmap
standalone_designs.summary: Cross-cutting roadmap for the quadruped monster's procedural animation: momentum and speed curves, attack wind-up and follow-through, and future wall climbing and wall jumping. Built atop the existing 2.5D projection, state machine, and cfg() systems.

standalone_designs.title: Input Mapping Reference
standalone_designs.summary: Cross-cutting reference for all input actions across PS5, Xbox, and keyboard, including hardcoded reads that bypass the Godot input map. Notes recommended improvements for remapping and ai_cmd test coverage of L2/R2/R1.

standalone_designs.title: Velocity Audit System
standalone_designs.summary: Proposed debug system that wraps all velocity writes behind a reason-tagging function so unexplained changes render as on-screen tracer arrows. Documented but not implemented; complements the existing SELECT-toggle debug rendering.

epics.title: Dual-Grapple Tether System
epics.summary: Extends the Ranger grapple into a two-point tether: grapple onto one anchor, then fire a second hook from that anchor's far end to a second anchor, connecting them with a physics rope that pulls strongly to a chosen length. Tethers respect entity mass and attachment-point weights, can be severed by damage, and are tracked in a 5-slot HUD inventory. A few tasks (self-tether, attack-through-rope damage, transition animations) remain open.

epics.title: Physics-Based Chain System
epics.summary: A multi-body physics chain replacing the single-Node2D chain, with rigid links, joint rotation, selective collision (players pass through, world drapes), per-link damage and breakage, and rope parity via elastic joints. Shipped as FABRIK rigid-link chains across v0.9.19-v0.10.28, with creature attachment and breakaway sequences.
